'''Bravo Ten''' was the callsign given to a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

[[Rhys Dallows]] served as Bravo Ten during to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. He ultimately survived the battle.
